result.content:
1: ## 1. Repository scaffolding
2: 
3: - [x] 1.1 Create top-level layout: `frontend/`, `backend/`, `infra/`, plus root `.env.example` documenting `MAX_UPLOAD_MB`, `MAX_DURATION_MIN`, `RETENTION_SECONDS`, `DEFAULT_MODEL`, `JOBS_DIR`, `MODEL_CACHE_DIR`, `WHISPER_VAD_ENABLED`, `SUB_MAX_CHARS_PER_LINE`, `SUB_MAX_LINES_PER_CUE`, `SUB_MAX_CUE_SECONDS`, `SUB_MIN_CUE_SECONDS`, `SUB_MIN_GAP_MS`
4: - [x] 1.2 Add root `README.md` with a one-paragraph project description, `docker compose up` quickstart, and a "this is a single-user / trusted-network deploy" warning
5: - [x] 1.3 Add `.gitignore` covering `node_modules/`, `dist/`, Python `__pycache__/`, `.venv/`, `jobs/`, `models/`, `.env`
6: 
7: ## 2. Backend — project setup
8: 
9: - [x] 2.1 Initialise `backend/` as a Python 3.11 project with `pyproject.toml` (uv or pip-tools), pinning `fastapi`, `uvicorn[standard]`, `python-multipart`, `faster-whisper`, `pydantic`, `pydantic-settings`
10: - [x] 2.2 Add `backend/Dockerfile` based on `nvidia/cuda:12.4.1-cudnn-runtime-ubuntu22.04`, installing `ffmpeg` and the Python dependencies; ensure CPU-only hosts can still build the image (no GPU build-time requirement)
11: - [x] 2.3 Add `backend/app/settings.py` loading the env vars from §1.1 via `pydantic-settings`, with the defaults from `design.md`
12: - [x] 2.4 Wire `backend/app/main.py` to create the FastAPI app, mount routers, and configure CORS for the frontend origin
13: 
14: ## 3. Backend — job state and storage
15: 
16: - [x] 3.1 Define `Job` model in `backend/app/jobs/model.py` with fields `id`, `state` (Enum `queued|extracting_audio|transcribing|done|failed`), `progress: float`, `error: Optional[str]`, `model`, `language`, `created_at`, `original_filename`, `language_detected`
17: - [x] 3.2 Implement `JobStore` in `backend/app/jobs/store.py` as an asyncio-safe in-memory dict keyed by job id with `create`, `get`, `update`, `delete`, `iter_expired` methods
18: - [x] 3.3 Implement `JobPaths` helper that returns the `JOBS_DIR/<id>/` directory and the canonical paths for `upload.<ext>`, `audio.wav`, `output.srt|txt|json`, `job.json`
19: - [x] 3.4 Persist a `job.json` snapshot alongside outputs on every state transition so `outputs` survive an in-memory restart even though the live job index does not (cleanup still uses directory mtime)
20: 
21: ## 4. Backend — upload API
22: 
23: - [x] 4.1 Add `POST /api/jobs` accepting multipart upload with `file`, optional `model`, optional `language`; validate format, size (`MAX_UPLOAD_MB`), and model value per `specs/video-upload/spec.md`
24: - [x] 4.2 Stream the upload to disk under the job working directory (do not buffer in memory)
25: - [x] 4.3 Create the Job record, enqueue the id onto the worker `asyncio.Queue`, and return `{job_id}` with `201 Created`
26: - [x] 4.4 Return `415` for unsupported formats, `413` for oversized uploads, `400` for invalid `model` values (per spec)
27: 
28: ## 4a. Backend — disk-aware upload + per-job timeout
29: 
30: - [x] 4a.1 Replace the static `MAX_UPLOAD_MB` enforcement with a disk-aware budget (`free_disk / 3` when `MAX_UPLOAD_MB = 0`, hard cap otherwise); return 413 with a zh-TW message that names the budget
31: - [x] 4a.2 Make the post-extraction duration check opt-in: skip entirely when `MAX_DURATION_MIN = 0`
32: - [x] 4a.3 Add `JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (default 7200, `0` disables) to `Settings`; surface in `.env.example`
33: - [x] 4a.4 Add `transcribe.Cancelled` exception and a `cancel: threading.Event` parameter to `transcribe.run` / `_do_transcribe`; the segment loop checks it every iteration
34: - [x] 4a.5 Worker wraps the transcribe call in `asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(future), timeout=…)`; on timeout, set the cancel event and await the future to actually exit before pulling the next job
35: - [x] 4a.6 Relax nginx `client_max_body_size` to `0` (server is the single source of truth for upload bounds)
36: - [x] 4a.7 Remove client-side `maxSize` enforcement in `<UploadZone>`; let the server's 413 surface through the mutation's error display
37: 
38: ## 5. Backend — worker pipeline
39: 
40: - [x] 5.1 Implement `audio.extract_wav(input, output)` that shells out to `ffmpeg -i <input> -ac 1 -ar 16000 -f wav <output>`, raising a typed error with stderr summary on non-zero exit
41: - [x] 5.2 Implement `transcribe.run(job)` that loads the configured Whisper model (cached at module level by `model` name), invokes it with `vad_filter=WHISPER_VAD_ENABLED`, iterates segments with progress updates, runs the layout pass (see §5a), and writes `output.srt|txt|json`
42: - [x] 5.3 Implement SRT renderer (cue index from 1, `HH:MM:SS,mmm` timestamps), TXT renderer (one cue per line, no timestamps, no `-->`), JSON renderer with `{language, duration, segments[{start,end,text}]}` per `specs/subtitle-export/spec.md` — all three consume the same post-processed cue array
43: - [x] 5.4 Implement the worker loop as a long-running asyncio task started at app startup: pulls one id at a time from the queue, runs extraction in a thread, runs transcription in a thread, updates Job state and progress at each step
44: - [x] 5.5 Enforce `MAX_DURATION_MIN` after extraction by reading `audio.wav` duration; mark `failed` with the duration error if exceeded
45: - [x] 5.6 Catch CUDA OOM during transcription, retry once with `compute_type="int8_float16"`, surface a clear error on second failure per `specs/transcription/spec.md`
46: 
47: ## 5a. Backend — subtitle layout module
48: 
49: - [x] 5a.1 Implement `backend/app/subtitles/width.py` with `width(s: str) -> int` that returns 2 for each CJK Unified Ideograph / Hiragana / Katakana / Hangul codepoint and 1 for everything else
50: - [x] 5a.2 Implement `backend/app/subtitles/layout.py:apply_layout(segments, config)` performing, in order: time-split long segments at sentence / comma / proportional boundary, line-wrap each cue's text to `SUB_MAX_CHARS_PER_LINE` width units, split over-`SUB_MAX_LINES_PER_CUE` cues by proportional duration, trim adjacent cues to enforce `SUB_MIN_GAP_MS`, and merge cues shorter than `SUB_MIN_CUE_SECONDS` when merging stays within limits
51: - [x] 5a.3 Unit tests for `width()` covering Han, Hiragana, Katakana, Hangul, ASCII, full-width punctuation
52: - [x] 5a.4 Unit tests for `apply_layout`: cases for time-split at sentence boundary, time-split at comma, time-split proportional fallback, CJK line wrap, ASCII line wrap, mixed CJK+ASCII wrap, gap trimming, tiny-cue merge, idempotence (applying twice yields the same result)
53: - [x] 5a.5 Wire the layout config dataclass to `Settings` so all five `SUB_*` env vars feed in with documented defaults
54: 
55: ## 6. Backend — status and download APIs
56: 
57: - [x] 6.1 Add `GET /api/jobs/{id}` returning `{state, progress, error?, outputs?, language_detected?}`; return `404` for unknown ids
58: - [x] 6.2 Add `GET /api/jobs/{id}/output/{format}` where format ∈ `srt|txt|json`, streaming the file with the right `Content-Type` and `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<original-stem>.<ext>"`
59: - [x] 6.3 Add `GET /api/health` returning `{status, jobs_dir_free_bytes, model_cache_present}` per `specs/job-lifecycle/spec.md`
60: 
61: ## 7. Backend — retention cleanup
62: 
63: - [x] 7.1 Implement a background asyncio task started at app startup that runs every 5 minutes
64: - [x] 7.2 For each job directory older than `RETENTION_SECONDS` whose Job state is terminal (`done` or `failed`) OR whose Job is no longer in the index, remove the directory and the index entry
65: - [x] 7.3 Skip directories whose Job state is `queued|extracting_audio|transcribing` regardless of age
66: 
67: ## 8. Backend — tests
68: 
69: - [x] 8.1 Unit tests for SRT / TXT / JSON renderers against a fixed post-processed cue fixture, asserting that all three reflect identical cue counts, timestamps, and text
70: - [x] 8.2 Unit test for `extract_wav` happy path (real ffmpeg, small sample file in `backend/tests/fixtures/`)
71: - [x] 8.3 Unit tests for `JobStore` covering create/get/update/delete and expiry iteration
72: - [x] 8.4 Integration test for `POST /api/jobs` rejecting oversized, unsupported-format, and invalid-model inputs — asserting the user-facing message in each error response is in zh-TW
73: - [x] 8.5 Integration test for the full lifecycle with a faster-whisper `tiny` model on a 5-second fixture: upload → poll → all three outputs downloadable
74: - [x] 8.6 Integration test for retention: jobs older than `RETENTION_SECONDS` disappear; active jobs do not
75: 
76: ## 9. Frontend — project setup
77: 
78: - [x] 9.1 Initialise `frontend/` as a Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project; set `<html lang="zh-TW">` and document the no-i18n convention (strings inlined in components) in a `frontend/README.md`
79: - [x] 9.1a Configure ESLint with `eslint-plugin-react`, `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`, `eslint-plugin-unicorn`, `@typescript-eslint`; enable `unicorn/filename-case: ["error", { case: "kebabCase" }]`, `react-hooks/rules-of-hooks: error`, `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps: error`, `max-lines-per-function: ["warn", { max: 150, skipBlankLines: true, skipComments: true }]`
80: - [x] 9.1b Add a `lint` npm script that runs ESLint over `src/`; wire it into `npm test` so CI catches violations
81: - [x] 9.1c Add `frontend/CONVENTIONS.md` summarising kebab-case file naming, minimize-useEffect ordering (derived → useMemo → event handler → useEffect), useMemo preference, ~150-line decomposition rule — with one concrete do/don't example per rule
82: - [x] 9.2 Add Tailwind CSS, configure `tailwind.config.js` for the SPA
83: - [x] 9.3 Add `@tanstack/react-query` and `react-dropzone`; set up a `QueryClientProvider` at the app root
84: - [x] 9.4 Add `frontend/Dockerfile` (multi-stage: build with Node, serve via nginx) and an `nginx.conf` that serves `/` from the built SPA and proxies `/api/*` to the backend service
85: 
86: ## 10. Frontend — upload flow
87: 
88: - [x] 10.1 Build the `<UploadZone>` component in `src/components/upload-zone.tsx` using `react-dropzone`: accepts the documented MIME types, refuses files larger than `MAX_UPLOAD_MB`, shows the limit
89: - [x] 10.2 Build the `<JobOptions>` form in `src/components/job-options.tsx`: model select (`medium` default, `large-v3`) with a zh-TW hint underneath the selector — "含英文術語的中文內容建議使用 large-v3" — and an optional language code input with a dropdown of common ISO 639-1 codes plus "自動偵測"; memoise the language dropdown options with `useMemo` (stable reference)
90: - [x] 10.3 Build the upload mutation hook in `src/hooks/use-upload-job.ts` that POSTs to `/api/jobs` with an `XMLHttpRequest`/`fetch` upload-progress handler so the UI can show a progress bar during the transfer
91: 
92: ## 11. Frontend — job progress and download
93: 
94: - [x] 11.1 Build a `useJob(jobId)` TanStack Query hook in `src/hooks/use-job.ts` that polls `/api/jobs/{id}` every 1000 ms while `state` is non-terminal, then stops (no `useEffect` — use TanStack Query's `refetchInterval` callback)
95: - [x] 11.2 Build the `<JobProgress>` view in `src/components/job-progress.tsx` that renders a labelled progress bar driven by `progress`, shows the current state in human zh-TW, and surfaces `error` when `state === "failed"`; derive the human-readable state label from a `useMemo`'d lookup table, not a re-rendered switch
96: - [x] 11.3 Build the `<DownloadPanel>` in `src/components/download-panel.tsx`, shown when `state === "done"`, with three buttons that hit `/api/jobs/{id}/output/{format}` and trigger browser downloads; memoise the URL tuple via `useMemo` keyed on job id
97: - [x] 11.4 Build `<JobView>` in `src/components/job-view.tsx` that composes `<JobProgress>` and `<DownloadPanel>` — keep the root `<App>` to the page layout shell only (upload vs job state) so no single component exceeds the ~150-line guideline
98: - [x] 11.5 Persist the active job id in `localStorage` via a single `useEffect` in `<App>` whose only job is the storage sync (synchronising React state with an external system — the canonical correct use of `useEffect`); on page load, if a stored id still returns a non-404, resume the job view automatically
99: 
100: ## 12. Frontend — tests
101: 
102: - [x] 12.1 Component test for `<UploadZone>` rejecting an oversized file
103: - [x] 12.2 Component test for `<JobProgress>` rendering each of `queued|extracting_audio|transcribing|done|failed` correctly
104: - [x] 12.3 Component test for `<DownloadPanel>` constructing the three download URLs from a fake job
105: - [x] 12.4 Snapshot test asserting that visible strings across `<UploadZone>`, `<JobOptions>`, `<JobProgress>`, `<DownloadPanel>` contain CJK characters (zh-TW guard against accidental English regressions)
106: - [x] 12.5 Lint gate: `npm run lint` exits non-zero in CI; pre-commit hook (via `husky` + `lint-staged`) runs ESLint on staged files so kebab-case / `exhaustive-deps` violations cannot land
107: 
108: ## 13. Infrastructure — docker-compose
109: 
110: - [x] 13.1 Write `infra/docker-compose.yml` with `frontend` and `backend` services, named volumes `jobs-volume` and `models-volume`, and a shared internal network
111: - [x] 13.2 Add the optional GPU block under `backend.deploy.resources.reservations.devices` guarded by a profile so CPU-only hosts can run `docker compose up` without modification
112: - [x] 13.3 Wire env vars from root `.env` into both services
113: - [x] 13.4 Document the model pre-warm command in `README.md`
114: 
115: ## 14. Manual verification
116: 
117: - [ ] 14.1 Run `docker compose up` on the dev machine; upload a 1-minute mp4; confirm SRT timestamps line up with the audio
118: - [ ] 14.2 Verify `large-v3` model path: upload the same file with `model=large-v3`, confirm output is produced (slower) and quality differs as expected
119: - [ ] 14.3 Verify rejection paths in the browser: oversized file, unsupported format, over-duration audio
120: - [ ] 14.4 Verify retention: upload a job, wait past `RETENTION_SECONDS`, confirm `GET /api/jobs/{id}` returns 404 and the directory is gone
121: - [ ] 14.5 Verify resume-on-reload: start a long job, reload the tab mid-transcription, confirm the UI re-attaches via `localStorage` and shows live progress
122: - [ ] 14.6 Verify VAD effect: transcribe a clip with ~30 s of trailing silence twice, once with `WHISPER_VAD_ENABLED=true` and once `false`; confirm the VAD-off run produces hallucinated cues in the silence region and the VAD-on run does not
123: - [ ] 14.7 Verify layout pass on a mixed Chinese / English clip: confirm SRT cues have ≤ 2 lines, ≤ 42 width units per line, ≤ 7 s duration, ≥ 100 ms gaps; spot-check that line breaks fall on punctuation when possible
124: - [ ] 14.8 Verify all UI strings and the API `error` field render in Traditional Chinese for: upload size rejection, unsupported format rejection, over-duration failure, OOM failure
